faqItems.question: Can I book a site visit?
faqItems.answer: Yes, share your preferred date and our advisor will coordinate the visit.

faqItems.question: Are documents verified?
faqItems.answer: Featured listings include basic ownership and documentation checks.

faqItems.question: Do you help with loans?
faqItems.answer: Loan and legal support can be coordinated after property shortlisting.

faqItems.question: What are the steps to buy an apartment?
faqItems.answer: Start with a budget and location shortlist, book site visits, verify documents, secure financing, and complete registration with our advisor guiding each step.

faqItems.question: What documents do I need?
faqItems.answer: Typically ID proof, address proof, income documents for loans, and property papers such as title deed, tax receipts, and NOC where applicable.

faqItems.question: Do you help with home loans and EMI planning?
faqItems.answer: Yes. We introduce bank partners, share indicative EMI ranges, and help you compare loan offers before you finalise a purchase. We can also share a quick EMI estimate during your consultation.

faqItems.question: Can I rent through HAUS Group as well?
faqItems.answer: Yes. We help with furnished and semi-furnished rentals across Gurugram, Noida, Delhi, Faridabad, and Ghaziabad — including visits, negotiation, and agreement support.

faqItems.question: Is there any charge for shortlisting or site visits?
faqItems.answer: Shortlists and guided site visits for buyers and renters are typically free. Any brokerage or service fee is shared transparently before you proceed.

PrivacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.desc: This policy explains how HAUS Group collects, uses, and protects personal information when you browse listings, book visits, or contact our advisors.

sections.title: Information we collect
sections.desc: We may collect your name, email, phone number, preferred locations, budget, and messages you submit through enquiry or visit-request forms. We may also collect basic technical data such as browser type and pages viewed to improve the website.

sections.title: How we use your information
sections.desc: We use your details to respond to property enquiries, schedule site visits, share relevant listings, coordinate documentation support, and send updates you request. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.

sections.title: Property enquiries and site visits
sections.desc: When you request a visit or shortlist, your information may be shared with assigned HAUS Group advisors and, where needed, with property owners or partners solely to arrange viewings and follow-ups.

sections.title: Cookies and analytics
sections.desc: We may use cookies or similar tools to understand how visitors use the site, remember preferences, and improve performance. You can control cookies through your browser settings.

sections.title: Data retention and security
sections.desc: We keep enquiry information only as long as needed for follow-up, legal, or service purposes. We take reasonable administrative and technical measures to protect your data from unauthorized access.

sections.title: Your choices
sections.desc: You may ask to review, update, or delete your contact details, or unsubscribe from marketing emails. Contact our team using the details in the footer or on the Contact page.

sections.title: Contact for privacy questions
sections.desc: For privacy-related requests, email our office or call the number listed in the footer. We will respond as promptly as possible.

post.title: 5 Signs You Need Professional Plumbing Help
post.intro: Plumbing problems can start small but quickly turn into major headaches if ignored. Knowing the warning signs early can save you time, money, and a lot of stress.
post.imageAlt: Plumber working on sink plumbing repair
post.author: Admin

points.title: Low Water Pressure
points.description: If your faucets or shower have weak water flow, it could indicate a hidden leak, pipe corrosion, or a problem with your water supply line. Low water pressure isn't just inconvenient—it can be a sign of a bigger issue in your plumbing system.

points.title: Slow Drains
points.description: A drain that takes too long to clear could be caused by a clog, buildup, or even a problem deep in your plumbing system. If plunging doesn't help, it's best to get a professional inspection before the issue worsens.

points.title: Unusual Noises
points.description: Banging, gurgling, or whistling sounds in your pipes are not normal. These noises can indicate air in the lines, loose pipes, or high water pressure, which could lead to more severe damage if not addressed.

points.title: Water Stains or Leaks
points.description: Water stains on walls or ceilings, or visible leaks under sinks, can lead to mold growth and structural damage if not fixed promptly. Even small leaks can waste a significant amount of water over time.

points.title: High Water Bills
points.description: An unexpected spike in your water bill could mean you have a hidden leak wasting water somewhere in your system. A professional plumber can find and fix leaks, helping you save money in the long run.

post.title: How to Prevent Common Drain Blockages
post.intro: Drain blockages are among the most frequent plumbing issues faced by homeowners. Preventative habits can keep your drains clear and free-flowing all year long.
post.author: Admin

points.title: Dispose of Cooking Grease Properly
points.description: Never pour fats, oils, or grease down your kitchen sink. Once cool, grease solidifies inside pipes, catching debris and causing severe line blockages.

points.title: Use Drain Strainers
points.description: Place mesh drain strainers over shower, tub, and sink drains to catch hair, soap scum, and food fragments before they enter your plumbing system.

points.title: Flush Drains with Hot Water
points.description: Run hot water down your drains weekly to melt minor buildup and clear soap residues before they turn into hardened clogs.

points.title: Avoid Flushing Non-Flushable Items
points.description: Wipes, paper towels, and sanitary products should never be flushed down toilets. Only toilet paper and waste should enter sewer lines.

points.title: Schedule Routine Hydro-Jetting Maintenance
points.description: Professional pipe flushing once a year keeps grease and mineral scale from gradually narrowing underground pipes.

post.title: DIY Plumbing Fixes You Can Do at Home
post.intro: Minor plumbing headaches can often be resolved with basic household tools. Here are safe, quick fixes you can handle without calling emergency services.

points.title: Unclogging a Toilet with the Right Plunger
points.description: Use a heavy-duty flange plunger for toilets to create an airtight seal. Push gently down first, then push vigorously to break up obstructions.

points.title: Replacing Worn Faucet Washers or O-Rings
points.description: A dripping faucet is usually caused by a degraded internal washer. Turn off water valves under the sink and swap out worn rubber seals.

points.title: Clearing Aerator Sediment Build-Up
points.description: Unscrew low-flow sink aerators and soak them in white vinegar to strip mineral deposits and restore full water spray velocity.

points.title: Fixing a Running Toilet Flapper
points.description: Adjust the chain length or replace a deteriorated rubber tank flapper seal so water stops running continuously into the toilet bowl.

points.title: Knowing When to Call a Pro
points.description: If main sewer lines back up, pipes burst, or water pressure drops across the whole house, turn off main shutoff valves and contact a professional.

posts.articleTitle: How to Keep Your Pets Healthy and Happy
posts.author: Dodo Cares Team
posts.introParagraph: Our pets rely on us for their care, love, and well-being. By following a few simple habits, you can ensure that your furry friends stay healthy, active, and happy through every stage of their lives.

contentPoints.title: 1. Provide a Balanced Diet
contentPoints.description: A nutritious, well-balanced diet is the foundation of your pet's health. Choose high-quality food that suits their age, size, and breed. Always ensure fresh water is available.

contentPoints.title: 2. Regular Exercise
contentPoints.description: Daily exercise keeps pets fit, maintains a healthy weight, and reduces stress and anxiety. Whether it's playtime, a walk, or indoor activities, keep your pet moving every day.

contentPoints.title: 3. Routine Grooming
contentPoints.description: Regular grooming keeps your pet clean, comfortable, and free from skin issues. Brushing, nail trimming, and ear cleaning should be part of your pet care routine.

contentPoints.title: 4. Regular Vet Check-ups
contentPoints.description: Routine veterinary check-ups help detect potential health issues early and keep your pet up to date on vaccinations and preventive care.

hero.subtitle: Reliable AC Services for a Cooler and Healthier Tomorrow

sections.title: AC Repair & Maintenance Service
sections.text: We provide professional AC repair and maintenance services for homes, offices and commercial spaces. Our experienced technicians ensure your AC runs efficiently with high performance, lower power consumption and longer life. From minor issues to major repairs, we handle everything with precision and care.

sections.title: Residential AC Repair
sections.text: From cooling problems and water leakage to unusual noise and gas refilling, we provide complete AC repair solutions for homes. Our certified technicians ensure safe and reliable service to keep your indoor spaces cool and comfortable.

sections.title: Commercial AC Repair
sections.text: We offer comprehensive AC repair and maintenance services for offices, shops, showrooms and industrial spaces. Our solutions are designed to meet higher cooling demands while ensuring minimal downtime and maximum efficiency.

sections.title: Quality & Safety Assurance
sections.text: We use genuine parts, high-quality refrigerant gas and advanced tools to ensure safe and long-lasting performance. All services are carried out by skilled and trained professionals who follow industry standards and safety guidelines.

sections.title: Why Choose Our AC Repair & Maintenance?
sections.text: With years of experience, skilled technicians and a customer-first approach, we have become a trusted name in AC repair and maintenance services. We provide transparent pricing, on-time service and dedicated support to ensure your complete satisfaction.

hero.subtitle: Perfect Fitting for Maximum Cooling and Efficiency

sections.title: AC Installation Service
sections.text: We install split, window, cassette and ducted air conditioners for homes, offices and commercial spaces. Our technicians assess your room size, wall strength and power supply to recommend the ideal placement for the best cooling and lowest power consumption.

sections.title: Split & Window AC Installation
sections.text: From wall-mounted indoor units to outdoor compressor brackets, copper piping, insulation and drain lines, we take care of every detail. Every installation is leak-tested and performance-checked before we hand it over.

sections.title: Uninstallation & Reinstallation
sections.text: Shifting homes or offices? We safely uninstall, pack and reinstall your AC at the new location with proper gas pumping, so you do not lose refrigerant or cooling performance.

sections.title: Why Choose Our Installation Service?
sections.text: Neat workmanship, genuine accessories, clear pricing and a post-installation service warranty make us the trusted choice for AC installation in your city.

hero.subtitle: Fresh, Germ-Free Air for a Healthier Home

sections.title: AC Cleaning & Sanitization Service
sections.text: Dust, mould and bacteria build up inside your AC over time, reducing cooling and affecting air quality. Our deep cleaning service removes dirt from filters, coils, blower and drain tray using foam jet and pressure wash techniques.

sections.title: Jet Pump Deep Cleaning
sections.text: We use high-pressure jet pumps to clean the evaporator and condenser coils thoroughly without damaging the fins, restoring airflow and improving cooling efficiency by up to 30%.

sections.title: Anti-Bacterial Sanitization
sections.text: After cleaning, we apply safe, eco-friendly anti-bacterial sprays that kill germs and eliminate bad odour, so your family breathes clean and fresh air.

sections.title: Why Regular Cleaning Matters
sections.text: Regular cleaning lowers electricity bills, prevents water leakage, reduces breakdowns and extends the life of your AC. We recommend a deep clean at least twice a year.

hero.subtitle: Restore Powerful Cooling with Genuine Refrigerant

sections.title: AC Gas Refilling Service
sections.text: If your AC is running but not cooling, low refrigerant could be the reason. We refill R32, R410A and R22 gases using calibrated gauges to ensure the exact pressure recommended by the manufacturer.

sections.title: Leak Detection & Repair
sections.text: Before refilling, we detect and fix leaks in pipes, joints and coils using nitrogen pressure testing, so the new gas stays in and your AC keeps cooling for longer.

sections.title: Genuine Refrigerant Only
sections.text: We use only branded, high-purity refrigerant gas that is safe for your compressor and the environment, avoiding the damage caused by adulterated gas.

sections.title: Why Choose Our Gas Refilling?
sections.text: Accurate pressure checks, complete leak repair, clear pricing per unit and a service warranty make our gas refilling reliable and worry-free.

hero.subtitle: Uniform Cooling for Large Homes and Commercial Spaces

sections.title: Ducted AC System Service
sections.text: Ducted air conditioning delivers even, quiet cooling to every room through hidden ducts. We design, install and service ducted systems for villas, offices, showrooms and restaurants.

sections.title: Design & Installation
sections.text: Our HVAC engineers calculate heat load, plan duct routes and select the right capacity units, ensuring balanced airflow, minimal noise and maximum energy efficiency.

sections.title: Duct Cleaning & Maintenance
sections.text: We clean ducts, grilles and diffusers, check insulation and balance dampers to keep the air clean and the system running at peak performance.

sections.title: Why Choose Our Ducted Solutions?
sections.text: End-to-end project handling, quality materials, skilled HVAC teams and dedicated after-sales support make us the right partner for ducted AC systems.

hero.subtitle: Year-Round Care with Priority Support and Savings

sections.title: AC Annual Maintenance Contract
sections.text: Our AMC plans keep your air conditioners in top condition all year with scheduled preventive services, priority breakdown support and discounted repairs for homes and businesses.

sections.title: What Our AMC Covers
sections.text: Each plan includes periodic deep cleaning, gas pressure checks, electrical inspection, drain line cleaning and performance testing, with free visits for any breakdowns during the contract.

sections.title: Plans for Homes & Businesses
sections.text: Choose from flexible plans for a single AC at home or multiple units across offices, shops and commercial buildings, with custom schedules to suit your operations.

sections.title: Why Choose Our AMC?
sections.text: Fewer breakdowns, lower power bills, longer AC life and predictable yearly costs. Our AMC customers also get priority booking during peak summer months.

hero.subtitle: Breathe Cleaner Air with High-Quality Filters

sections.title: AC Filter Replacement Service
sections.text: Clogged or damaged filters block airflow, reduce cooling and circulate dust and allergens. We replace old filters with genuine, correctly sized filters for all major AC brands.

sections.title: HEPA & Anti-Bacterial Filters
sections.text: Upgrade to HEPA, carbon or anti-bacterial filters that trap fine dust, smoke, pollen and germs, ideal for families with kids, elderly members or allergy sufferers.

sections.title: When to Replace Your Filter
sections.text: If you notice weak airflow, bad odour, more dust indoors or higher electricity bills, it is time to replace your filter. We recommend checking filters every 2-3 months.

sections.title: Why Choose Our Filter Service?
sections.text: Genuine parts, the right fit for your model, quick doorstep service and honest advice on whether a clean or a replacement is really needed.

hero.subtitle: Safe Wiring and Power Solutions for Your AC

sections.title: AC Electrical Work Service
sections.text: Faulty wiring, tripping MCBs and voltage problems can damage your AC and create safety hazards. Our trained electricians handle all AC-related electrical work safely and professionally.

sections.title: Wiring, MCB & Stabilizer Setup
sections.text: We install dedicated power points, correctly rated MCBs, earthing and voltage stabilizers to protect your AC compressor and electronics from power fluctuations.

sections.title: PCB & Component Repair
sections.text: From PCB faults and capacitor failures to fan motor and thermostat issues, we diagnose and repair electrical components using genuine spare parts.

sections.title: Why Choose Our Electrical Service?
sections.text: Certified electricians, strict safety standards, quality materials and clear pricing ensure your AC runs safely and reliably for years.

posts.title: How AI Reads Your Face Shape in 3 Seconds
posts.excerpt: A behind-the-scenes look at the landmark detection that powers every recommendation.

image.alt: Barber tools and clippers on a workstation

content.intro: Choosing a haircut used to be guesswork. Today, smart face-mapping technology can analyse your features in seconds and suggest styles that flatter you best. Here's how it works and how our stylists use it to give you better results.

sections.heading: Mapping Facial Landmarks
sections.body: The technology identifies key points on your face — forehead width, cheekbones, jawline and chin. These landmarks create a precise outline of your face shape, whether oval, round, square, heart or diamond.

sections.heading: Measuring Proportions
sections.body: Once the landmarks are mapped, the system compares length and width ratios. These proportions reveal which features to balance and which to highlight with the right cut and volume.

sections.heading: Matching Styles
sections.body: Your face shape is matched against hundreds of hairstyles that are known to complement it. The result is a shortlist of looks tailored to your features — not just the latest trend.

sections.heading: The Stylist's Touch
sections.body: Technology gives a great starting point, but our stylists consider your hair texture, lifestyle and personality to refine the final recommendation into a look that's truly yours.

content.conclusion: Face-mapping makes your consultation faster and more accurate, but the magic still happens in the chair. Book a consultation at Hair Atelier and let our experts combine smart insights with skilled hands.

posts.title: 5 Hairstyles That Will Define 2026
posts.excerpt: Our trend radar reveals the cuts about to dominate barbershops worldwide.

content.intro: The world of hairstyling is constantly evolving, and 2026 is bringing a fresh wave of trends that are stylish, versatile and perfect for every personality. Whether you love classic looks or prefer something modern and bold, this year's hairstyle trends offer something for everyone. In this blog, we'll explore five stunning hairstyles that are set to dominate in 2026 and how you can make them work for your unique style.

sections.heading: Soft Layered Waves
sections.body: Soft, effortless waves with face-framing layers continue to be a timeless favourite. This look adds natural volume, movement and a youthful charm, making it perfect for both casual and formal occasions. It suits almost all hair types and can be styled with minimal effort.

sections.heading: Sleek Blunt Bob
sections.body: The blunt bob is making a huge statement in 2026. With its clean, sharp edges and sleek finish, this hairstyle gives a modern, confident and sophisticated look. It works beautifully on straight and slightly wavy hair and is easy to maintain, making it a top choice for busy lifestyles.

sections.heading: Curtain Bangs
sections.body: Curtain bangs remain a top trend, adding softness and dimension to any hairstyle. They frame the face beautifully and work well with long, medium or even short hair. Curtain bangs are versatile and can be styled with waves, straight looks or updos.

sections.heading: Textured Shag Cut
sections.body: The modern shag cut is all about texture, volume and a relaxed, edgy vibe. This hairstyle is perfect for those who want a trendy, low-maintenance look with lots of personality. It adds movement and works great for both straight and wavy hair.

sections.heading: Glossy High Ponytail
sections.body: A sleek, high ponytail with a glossy finish is a go-to style for a chic and polished appearance. It's versatile, easy to achieve and perfect for both everyday wear and special events. You can keep it ultra-sleek or add soft waves for a more relaxed look.

content.conclusion: 2026 is all about hairstyles that enhance your natural beauty while allowing you to express your individuality. From soft waves to edgy cuts, these trends are designed to suit every hair type and lifestyle. Visit Hair Atelier today and let our expert stylists help you achieve the perfect look for 2026.

posts.title: How to Choose the Right Haircut for Your Face Shape
posts.excerpt: A simple guide to finding the cut that balances your features and suits your lifestyle.

image.alt: Barber discussing a haircut with a client

content.intro: The right haircut can completely transform how you look and feel. The secret lies in understanding your face shape and choosing a style that balances your features. Here's a quick guide to help you pick the perfect cut.

sections.heading: Oval Face
sections.body: Lucky you — almost every style works. Try long layers, a sleek bob or a textured crop. Avoid heavy fringes that hide your balanced proportions.

sections.heading: Round Face
sections.body: Add height and length to create definition. Long layers, side-swept bangs and volume at the crown help elongate the face beautifully.

sections.heading: Square Face
sections.body: Soften strong jawlines with waves, layers and side parts. Textured lobs and curtain bangs add a gentle, flattering touch.

sections.heading: Heart Face
sections.body: Balance a wider forehead with chin-length bobs, side-swept fringes and volume around the jaw to create harmony.

content.conclusion: Your face shape is a great guide, but your hair texture and lifestyle matter too. Book a personal consultation at Hair Atelier and our stylists will recommend a cut that's made for you.

posts.title: The Science of a Perfectly Healthy Beard
posts.excerpt: From follicle care to AI-matched oils — build a routine that actually works.

image.alt: Client receiving a beard trim and shave

content.intro: A great beard doesn't happen by accident. Healthy growth starts at the follicle and depends on the right cleansing, nourishment and grooming routine. Here's the science behind a beard that looks full, soft and well-kept.

sections.heading: Start with the Skin
sections.body: Healthy beard hair grows from healthy skin. Cleanse and exfoliate gently to remove dead cells and prevent ingrown hairs and itchiness.

sections.heading: Nourish with Oils
sections.body: Beard oils with jojoba, argan or almond oil mimic natural sebum, keeping both hair and skin hydrated and reducing flakes.

sections.heading: Trim Regularly
sections.body: Regular trims remove split ends and keep the shape sharp. A professional shape-up every 3–4 weeks makes a huge difference.

sections.heading: Lifestyle Matters
sections.body: Sleep, hydration, a protein-rich diet and stress management all influence beard growth and thickness.

content.conclusion: Consistency is the key to a healthy beard. Pair a simple daily routine with expert grooming at Hair Atelier for a beard that always looks its best.
